summary: Avricore Health Inc. filed a Form 6-K for the month of June 2026, attaching interim financial statements for March 31, 2026, MD&A, certifications, a news release on a C$1.254 million financing close, and an exempt distribution report. The financing terms (price, shares, structure) are not detailed in this excerpt. The board has not made a recommendation cited. The filing is a routine periodic update with a capital raise, not a transformative event. No special-situation catalyst such as a merger, tender, or activist campaign is present. Watch for future filings detailing the financing terms and use of proceeds.
